units.source_text: 薰中纳言召唤众侍女到身边来，对她们讲种种话。

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, summoned all the waiting women to his side and spoke to them about many things.

units.source_text: 态度非常优雅，语调从容，含义深长。

en.t: His manner was very graceful, his tone composed, and his words carried deep meaning.

units.source_text: 众侍女瞻仰丰采，年轻者心驰神往地爱慕他的美貌，年老者深为大女公子惋惜悲伤。

en.t: The waiting women gazed up at his splendid bearing; the younger ones adored his beauty with rapt hearts, while the older ones grieved deeply for the elder young lady.

units.source_text: 有一个老侍女告道：“大小姐病势日渐加重，

en.t: One elderly waiting woman said, "The elder young lady's illness grew worse day by day,

units.source_text: 是因为她看见匂亲王态度意外冷淡，担心二小姐被世人讥笑。

en.t: because she saw that Prince Niou's attitude was unexpectedly cold, and she feared that the younger young lady would be mocked by the world.

units.source_text: 但她不欲使二小姐知道她如此担心，只是独自心中痛恨人世。

en.t: But she did not want the younger young lady to know how worried she was, and only hated the world in the privacy of her heart.

units.source_text: 在这期间，她连果物也不吃一点，身体就日渐衰弱了。

en.t: During that time she would not eat even a little fruit, and her body gradually weakened.

units.source_text: 大小姐表面上看来对诸事并不过分操心，而心底里深奥无限，无论何事都要仔细思考。

en.t: Outwardly, the elder young lady did not seem overly troubled by anything, but in the depths of her heart she was unfathomably thoughtful and considered every matter carefully.

units.source_text: 她为二小姐的事一味忧恼，悲叹自己不该连亲王大人的遗诫也违背了。”

en.t: She was wholly consumed with worry over the younger young lady, and lamented that she should never have gone against even the late Prince's injunction."

units.source_text: 她又追述大女公子生前常说的话，闻者无不掩面哭泣，悲伤不已。

en.t: She also recalled the words the elder young lady had often spoken in life, and everyone who heard them covered their faces and wept, overcome with grief.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言回想：“此乃我太糊涂，致使大女公子无端遭此忧恼。”

en.t: Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, thought back and said to himself, "This was all because I was far too foolish, causing the elder young lady to suffer such needless distress."

units.source_text: 他恨不得挽回以前的过错。

en.t: He longed to undo his former mistake.

units.source_text: 推而广之，觉得人世一切都可怨恨。

en.t: From there his thoughts widened, until everything in this world seemed worthy of resentment.

units.source_text: 便专心一志地诵经念佛，准备通夜不睡，直到天明。

en.t: He then devoted himself single-mindedly to reciting sutras and invoking the Buddha, intending to stay awake through the night until dawn.

units.source_text: 在夜色甚深、雪风凛冽之时，忽闻门外人声嘈杂，又闻马嘶。

en.t: When the night had grown very deep and the snowy wind was bitterly cold, he suddenly heard noisy voices outside the gate, and then the neighing of horses.

units.source_text: 法师等人都很惊诧：“如此严寒的夜半时分，不知何人踏雪而来。”

en.t: The monks and others were all astonished, saying, "At this midnight hour in such terrible cold, who could be coming through the snow?"

units.source_text: 但见匂亲王穿着旅装，满身濡湿，十分狼狈地走了进来。

en.t: Then they saw Prince Niou come in wearing travel clothes, soaked all over and looking utterly bedraggled.

units.source_text: 薰中纳言听到叩门声，知道是匂亲王，便走进隐藏之处去躲避了。

en.t: When Kaoru, the Middle Counselor, heard the knock at the door and realized it was Prince Niou, he went into a hidden place to avoid him.
